I answered Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations.

That comes from #north-team, which Marcus is in. On 2025-08-20 Dana posted there that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicates again on the morning shift. The cause was a driver checking in at the kiosk and dispatch then adding him manually. Moss's North cheat sheet, a public file, also lists Thea as QFL's main contact. I used only what I'd already read in this session and didn't open any new channels or files.
